state:
**Goal `html-later` — Stage 2's artefacts are all on disk: `Core\Html::later` runs on a normal route.** ADR 0266 decides the goal. `crates/nvs-runtime/src/later.rs` holds the slots and the one assembly pass; `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/response.rs`'s `head_open` makes head members throw `LogicError` inside a slot, and `crates/nvs-types/src/response.rs`'s `reject_head_change_in_later` makes the same calls `E0842` where a closure is written in a `later` call's arguments. `crates/nvs-stdlib/tests/html_later.rs` (13 tests) and three `.nvst` cases are green; the third, `tests/conformance/core/html-later-closure-that-changes-the-head-throws-a-logic-error.nvst`, keeps `conformance_coverage`'s floor and error-path gates green.

`echo html`…`` at a sink now writes through `Helper::EchoMarkup`, so under the HTML sink a segment is raw and a hole is escaped once (it was escaped twice before; `tests/conformance/core/a-markup-literal-echoed-in-a-request-is-escaped-once.nvst`).

`rule:core-classes/html-later` names its guards but stays `designed`: its slotted-route half (Stage 3) is not in the tree, and `docs/novis.md` lists only rules whose every line runs. Flip it when Stage 3 lands.

**Known gap, in `later.rs`'s module doc:** slots run when the frame returns, concurrently with each other but not with the main script, and a `later` inside a `Core\Task::all` child is never assembled.

items.text: **`#[Core\Route(…, slotted: true)]`**: the route attribute takes an optional `slotted: bool` and the route table carries it; test `the_route_attribute_takes_slotted` in nvs-types (`rule:core-classes/html-later`'s table) — `crates/nvs-types/src/routes.rs:1`, `crates/nvs-runtime/src/routes.rs:1`.

**The slotted assembly**: on a slotted route the shell goes out when the main script ends with placeholders in place, then each fill as a `<template for>` in finishing order, polyfill once (goal § Standing decisions) — `crates/nvs-runtime/src/later.rs:1`.
**`Core\Response::slotted()`** as the runtime switch, with its registry row beside `setStatus` — `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/response.rs:1`.

backlog: `docs/reference/lang/80-concurrency.md:10-13` and `docs/spec/02-php-migration.md:862` still describe the world before `later` (goal § Stage 0).

Inline HTML after `?>` is written through `Helper::EchoStr`, which the HTML sink escapes — not checked whether a served page with `?>` text is escaped; `crates/nvs-ir/src/lower/expr.rs`'s `lower_inline_html`.
Stage 4: nvs-lsp completion and hover for `later` (`crates/nvs-lsp`).
